upgradeModal2.planUnavailable: This plan isn't available for purchase right now. Please try again shortly.
upgradeModal2.paymentFailed: Payment failed — your plan was not upgraded.
upgradeModal2.paymentFailedSub: Please update your payment method in billing settings and try again.
upgradeModal2.cancelInAppStore: Cancel or change your plan any time in the App Store's subscription settings.
upgradeModal2.alreadySubscribed: Already subscribed on this Apple ID?
upgradeModal2.appleRefundNote: Billed through your Apple ID. Refunds are handled by Apple under App Store policy.
upgradeModal2.appleCancelBody: You'll cancel in your Apple ID subscription settings. You keep all your current features until the end of your billing period.
upgradeModal2.appleDowngradeSub: Your current plan access continues until your next billing date, then switches automatically.
upgradeModal2.appleBilling1: Subscriptions auto-renew at the listed price and are billed to your Apple ID. They renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
upgradeModal2.appleBilling2: Refunds. Purchases made in the iOS app are billed by Apple. Refunds are handled solely by Apple under the App Store's policies — you can request one at reportaproblem.apple.com.
upgradeModal2.appleBilling3: Cancellation. You can cancel at any time in your Apple ID subscription settings. Cancellation takes effect at the end of your current billing period — you keep full access until then, after which your account reverts to the Free tier.
upgradeModal2.appleBilling4: Plan upgrades take effect immediately; Apple applies any proration under its subscription rules.
upgradeModal2.appleBilling5: Plan downgrades take effect at your next renewal. You keep your higher-tier access until then.
